name.ja: 青井岳温泉・青井岳キャンプ場

address.ja: 宮崎県都城市山之口町山之口2123
address.ko: 미야자키현 미야코노조시 山之口町山之口2123

price.en: Entry 700–1,000 yen/adult, 350–500 yen/child (tax incl.). Tent site 1,000–1,400 yen/pitch + per-person fees. RV park 2,000–2,800 yen/vehicle (power/water). Cabin 10,000–14,000 yen/room, log house 19,000–36,000 yen/unit.

description.ja: 青井岳の温泉と、同じ敷地のキャンプ場・RVパーク・車中泊エリア。RVサイトは電源・水場あり。
description.en: Aoidake hot spring with an on-site campsite, JRVA RV park, and car-stay bays. RV sites have power and water.
description.ko: 아오이다케 온천과 같은 부지의 캠프장·RV 파크·차박 구역. RV 사이트에는 전원과 급수 있음.
